source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Board A of the Singles Event Companion is for Take and Hold against Purge the Foe. The Take and Hold player plays Immovable Object and the Purge the Foe player plays Unstoppable Force. The app pairs this board with the Sweeping Engagement deployment. Neither disposition fixes the Attacker or Defender role; a roll-off settles that. Every zone, territory, objective and terrain position comes only from the official board image, and this entry states no measurements. Its lettered terrain pieces refer to the parts of the Battlefields: Armageddon kit.
